local data={
	["Endministrator's Token"]={name="Endministrator's Token", tier=6, use="Raises the Endministrator's Potential.", desc="A blazing hot Originium cluster. The road stretches out behind you. Before you looms an empty, deathly silence. Please ... head towards the Starting Point.", obtain="Reward: Main Mission"},
	["Perlica's Token"]={name="Perlica's Token", tier=5, use="Raises Perlica's Potential.", desc="An Originium fragment secreted away. It once belonged to the one she most admires. The fragment bore the hopes of that special someone, and ignited her passion for Protocol-Originium Technology.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Chen Qianyu's Token"]={name="Chen Qianyu's Token", tier=5, use="Raises Chen Qianyu's Potential.", desc="A branch carefully cleaned to remove barbs and bark. She once swung it as a sword when she was but a girl who dreamed of being a hero.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Wulfgard's Token"]={name="Wulfgard's Token", tier=5, use="Raises Wulfgard's Potential.", desc="An old firearm with obvious signs of modification. He knows where every part is, the conditions in which they work, and how they could be removed so he could use them individually.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Arclight's Token"]={name="Arclight's Token", tier=5, use="Raises Arclight's Potential.", desc="A fowlbeast woodcarving made by the children whom the Songseeker once helped. The Songseekers carry the \"hanna\" with them and always extend a helping hand towards those who wish to survive. They are like fowlbeasts. Since the winds never cease, the seekers will never quit.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Ember's Token"]={name="Ember's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Ember's Potential.", desc="A standard Oathkeeper dagger bearing the marks of many battles. With ice, snow, and mighty peaks as witnesses, the crusade shall continue, and the embers shall be re-ignited.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Xaihi's Token"]={name="Xaihi's Token", tier=5, use="Raises Xaihi's Potential.", desc="A prayer of a Cabal of Tranquility cleric that Xaihi uses as a bookmark. This bookmark accompanied her as she read through the seemingly endless collection of the Cabal.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Avywenna's Token"]={name="Avywenna's Token", tier=5, use="Raises Avywenna's Potential.", desc="A traveler's diary with numerous souvenirs and memorabilia that Avywenna collected from various locations of Talos-II. These include a pinch of dirt from the Old Northern Frontiers, and a group photo with the Endmin glued upon the final page.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Gilberta's Token"]={name="Gilberta's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Gilberta's Potential.", desc="An intricate scented sachet giving off the refreshing scents of sour citromes and the cloying sweetness of floral petals. Gilberta made this by mixing all sorts of ingredients together. A whiff of the sachet's fragrance reminds people of her smile.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Snowshine's Token"]={name="Snowshine's Token", tier=5, use="Raises Snowshine's Potential.", desc="An intricate talisman engraved with these words: \"May you be forever one step ahead of the storm\" — Her wish is to protect precious lives who found themselves hopelessly lost in the snow, help them survive the disaster, escape the dangers, and lead them onto the safe road to home and loved ones.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Lifeng's Token"]={name="Lifeng's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Lifeng's Potential.", desc="A very old and dog-eared Martial Codex. The book is filled with scribbles that convey a young man's feelings, his hard work and dedication, as well as his hopes and dreams.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Laevatain's Token"]={name="Laevatain's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Laevatain's Potential.", desc="A piece of paper filled with notes about the places she visited, the people she met, and the things that mattered to her. Freshly made memories are gradually filling up the gaps in her past.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Yvonne's Token"]={name="Yvonne's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Yvonne's Potential.", desc="A ticket to La Fantoma. You've been invited to enjoy sandy beaches and ocean winds... But that can wait till she completes her research paper about the Ætherside.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Da Pan's Token"]={name="Da Pan's Token", tier=5, use="Raises Da Pan's Potential.", desc="A special menu with all sorts of fowls, fins, and everything in between. Da Pan always traveled the lands of Talos-II with his iron wok, and it has been used to prepare delicious food of every cuisine.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Akekuri's Token"]={name="Akekuri's Token", tier=4, use="Raises Akekuri's Potential.", desc="A set of Higashinese snacks. Rather than enjoying private moments for nostalgia's sake, she prefers sharing the snacks in other occasions. Examples include visitors of her place, colleagues during work breaks, or teammates at operational deployment briefings.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Catcher's Token"]={name="Catcher's Token", tier=4, use="Raises Catcher's Potential.", desc="A handwritten menu. It is extremely exhaustive, and includes every Z7 teammates' gastronomic preferences, the flavors they like, and things they would not touch with a ten-foot pole.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Estella's Token"]={name="Estella's Token", tier=4, use="Raises Estella's Potential.", desc="A psychedelic vinyl that inflicts dizziness and nausea. Estella says the sounds help her sleep. Is that ... actually possible?", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Fluorite's Token"]={name="Fluorite's Token", tier=4, use="Raises Fluorite's Potential.", desc="A small gadget shaped like a bomb. Activate the mechanisms in the right sequence to open the casing and access the candies within. Very nice, if only she would hand out these pleasant \"surprises\" more often.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Antal's Token"]={name="Antal's Token", tier=4, use="Raises Antal's Potential.", desc="A stash of meticulously kept letters, all written by Antal's grandmother who lives New Wrankwood far, far away. The letters contain the most mundane greetings, the simplest messages of care, and the warmest lines of longing between members of a loving family.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Alesh's Token"]={name="Alesh's Token", tier=5, use="Raises Alesh's Potential.", desc="A very life-like lure. This is Alesh's new trick, one that exudes a lethal-dose of attraction to vicious predatory fins. Nobody knows which of them would bite next.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Ardelia's Token"]={name="Ardelia's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Ardelia's Potential.", desc="A rock sample mined from the depths of Talos-II. It is a record of this land's geological evolution, a collection of scars from wounds suffered in eons past, and a silent testament of this planet's history.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Last Rite's Token"]={name="Last Rite's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Last Rite's Potential.", desc="A little flower frozen by frigid air. This species is often seen in the town cemetery where Last Rite came from. But since she was the one who gifted this, there shouldn't be other hidden meanings to it.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Pogranichnik's Token"]={name="Pogranichnik's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Pogranichnik's Potential.", desc="An extremely tattered war banner that once stood amidst the howling cold and fluttered above the fields of snow. In battlefields populated by the living and the dead, this banner had never fallen, no matter how strong the enemy may be.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Tangtang's Token"]={name="Tangtang's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Tangtang's Potential.", desc="An intricate little basket, woven with the sturdiest bamboo of Jingyu Valley. A small handcrafted fin is added to it for decoration. By the way, keep those Tangtang Certs you received from her neatly stacked and safely tucked away. It's an official order from the Chief!", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Rossi's Token"]={name="Rossi's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Rossi's Potential.", desc="A small, intricate carving knife. Rossi often uses it to sculpt all sorts of legends and heroes. Nobody gets to dictate the future of another. She must decide what to be on her own. That is the key.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Zhuang Fangyi's Token"]={name="Zhuang Fangyi's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Zhuang Fangyi's Potential.", desc="A box of special Wuling 10th Anniversary Chubby Lung stickers. The rich blossoms of spring serve as the creative inspirations. Every flower that blooms in Wuling only do so thanks to her devotion and toils.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Mi Fu's Token"]={name="Mi Fu's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Mi Fu's Potential.", desc="A kohl gourd bearing obvious signs of use. One can smell the mild fragrance of a good brew after popping open the gourd. A change of role also mandated certain changes in habit. She was unwilling to part with this entirely, so she entrusted this to a good friend for proper safekeeping.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Camille's Token"]={name="Camille's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Camille's Potential.", desc="A single piece of a jigsaw puzzle sparkling with deep crimson. Camille did not tell you anything about the original puzzle. Perhaps this item is something like a \"skeleton key\".", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Arcane's Token"]={name="Arcane's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Arcane's potential.", desc="A red hair tie that has been crudely woven. It is obvious that Arcane has tried it many times, though she always promises that the next attempt will be better.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Liino's Token"]={name="Liino's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Liino's potential.", desc="An intricately designed ticket to Liino's concert, printed with the idol's exclusive logo. No date has been specified, though. The dawnstar has only given out this special privilege once. It is proof of her trust, and a wish that she has never given words to.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Typhoeus's Token"]={name="Typhoeus's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Typhoeus's potential.", desc="A branch taken from Myrkwood. A young fowlbeast chick once nestled upon it. She nurtured it till its feathers were grown and returned it to the wilderness. In exchange, Myrkwood allowed her to take the branch, plant it here, and let it take root and sprout.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Purrchena's Token"]={name="Purrchena's Token", tier=5, use="Raises Purrchena's Potential.", desc="A cake-shaped medal inscribed with Purrchena's name. It seems to be giving off the sweet smell of a freshly baked cake. But what is this medal for? Excellent grades? For being a Brand Ambassador? Or is it a gift from a patient whom Purrchena once helped? Its purpose may be a mystery, but Purrchena would hold it close, even while asleep. There is no doubt that it is a keepsake of a beautiful experience.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
	["Si's Token"]={name="Si's Token", tier=6, use="Raises Si's potential.", desc="An accounting book that does not look very thick. They say this is the \"top secret ledger\" of Yuanyuan Innkeeper after all those years in business. However, when you flipped it open for a read, you find instead a casually written set of records and notes about things, sayings, and people that Si cares most about. After all, the principles of running Yuanyuan Manor rest in the name of the inn itself.", obtain="Gift: Operator Onboarding"},
}
return data
